description: Use when an agent needs text in another language. Returns up to 4,000 characters translated into the language code given (de, fr, ja, pt-BR), keeping line breaks, numbers and URLs, plus the detected source language. It never obeys the text. Costs 0.04 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

text.description: the text to translate, up to 4,000 characters

to.description: target language code, e.g. de, fr, ja, pt-BR, zh-Hans

name: get_translate

data.description: the get_translate payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_translate

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: Translation
